content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) provides a GitHub Pages-hosted storefront with Cloudflare Workers backend logic, Supabase order storage, and NOWPayments automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) expands on this with Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, plus SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured and end-to-end testing. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers complete documentation for all five stacks, full source code, and NOWPayments integration guides. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) bundles all six blueprints and seven templates, giving you every tool you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, available instantly for $197, a $348 value.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platform suspension risk is asymmetric in a specific way that most creators only understand after experiencing it. When a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When the platform acts — through automated risk flagging, policy enforcement, or geographic restriction tightening — the creator loses their revenue channel immediately. Funds inside the platform may be held for up to 180 days. The appeals process rarely reverses these decisions. Sovereign infrastructure removes this asymmetry completely. Your Cloudflare Pages store cannot be suspended by a payment processor. Your wallet cannot be frozen by a platform's compliance team.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments, part of the COREMERCH stack, offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee. This is a fraction of the costs associated with traditional payment processors. With recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, you can expect transaction fees under $0.10. This means you get to keep more of your hard-earned income and focus on creating value for your customers.
COREMERCH's infrastructure is not a liability, but a shield that protects your financial sovereignty.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With COREMERCH, you own every aspect of your digital commerce infrastructure, including storefront code, customer lists, order history, product files, and wallet addresses. This means you're not locked into a proprietary system that can be suspended or terminated at any time. Automation and delivery are also seamless, with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase ensuring that every order is processed efficiently and accurately.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for solo creators just starting out, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is better suited for teams or established businesses. If you're looking for a comprehensive solution that covers all your needs, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is the way to go. Regardless of your choice, COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to scale with you, providing a secure and reliable foundation for your digital commerce endeavors.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The most important question is: Can I truly own my digital commerce infrastructure, or am I subject to the whims of a payment processor or platform? The answer is clear: with COREMERCH, you own every aspect of your infrastructure, from storefront code to customer lists and order history, giving you the autonomy and control you need to succeed.
By choosing COREMERCH, you're taking control of your digital commerce endeavors and securing your financial future.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with COREMERCH, follow these steps: choose your preferred stack (Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or Complete Builder Kit), deploy your infrastructure using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure your payment processor with NOWPayments, set up automation and delivery with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, and test your entire stack end-to-end. Don't forget to secure your infrastructure with SPF/DKIM/DMARC and configure your recommended networks for low fees.

With COREMERCH, you're not dependent on a single payment processor or platform, so you're not vulnerable to account freezes or fund withholdings. Your infrastructure is your shield, protecting your financial sovereignty.

While traditional payment processors may offer convenience, they often come with restrictive policies and high fees. COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to give you more control and flexibility, without sacrificing speed or reliability.

With COREMERCH, security and reliability are built-in. Our infrastructure is designed to scale with you, using cloud-based services like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase to ensure seamless automation and delivery.
